units.source_text: 黄昏过后不久，河上忽然起风，声甚凄厉。

en.t: Not long after dusk, a sudden wind rose over the river, and its sound was terribly mournful.

units.source_text: 不甚坚固的板窗被吹得格格地响。

en.t: The none too sturdy wooden shutters were blown about, rattling noisily.

units.source_text: 弁君窃喜有这些声响掩护，人的脚步声可以不被听出，便引导薰君进两女公子的卧室中去。

en.t: Lady Ben was secretly glad that these noises would cover them and keep their footsteps from being heard, and she led Lord Kaoru into the bedchamber of the two young ladies.

units.source_text: 她知道两女公子睡在一处，觉得不甚方便。

en.t: She knew that the two young ladies slept in the same place, and felt that this was rather inconvenient.

units.source_text: 但她又想：“她们是经常如此的，我怎么可以劝她们今夜分房而睡呢？

en.t: But then she thought, "They always sleep this way, so how could I advise them to sleep in separate rooms tonight?

units.source_text: 好在薰中纳言认得大小姐，不会弄错。”

en.t: Fortunately, Middle Counselor Kaoru knows the elder sister and will not mistake her."

units.source_text: 大女公子一直不曾睡着，忽然听见脚步声，立刻起身逃走。

en.t: The elder young lady had not been asleep at all; when she suddenly heard footsteps, she immediately got up and fled.

units.source_text: 她想起自己迅速躲避，而妹妹还在无心无思地酣睡，觉得对她不起。

en.t: Thinking that she herself had quickly hidden away while her younger sister still slept soundly without the least awareness, she felt she had wronged her.

units.source_text: 然而有什么办法呢？

en.t: But what could she do?

units.source_text: 心中非常难过。

en.t: Her heart was filled with unbearable distress.

units.source_text: 她很想唤她醒来，和她一同逃避。

en.t: She longed to wake her and escape together with her.

units.source_text: 然而已经来不及了。

en.t: But it was already too late.

units.source_text: 她浑身发抖，从一旁窥看，但见幽暗的灯火光中，薰君穿着衬衣，装着熟悉的样子，

en.t: Trembling all over, she peered from the side and saw, in the dim lamplight, Lord Kaoru in his underrobe, acting as though he knew the place well,

units.source_text: 撩起帷屏上的垂布，钻进里面来。

en.t: lifting the hanging cloth of the screen and slipping inside.

units.source_text: 大女公子想：“妹妹真可怜！

en.t: The elder young lady thought, "My poor younger sister!

units.source_text: 叫她怎么办呢？”

en.t: What is she to do?"

units.source_text: 那粗劣的墙壁旁边立着一个屏风，她就躲进屏风背后的肮脏地方去。

en.t: Beside the crude wall stood a folding screen, and she hid in the dirty space behind it.

units.source_text: 她想：“昼间我劝妹妹结婚，她尚且埋怨我。

en.t: She thought, "Even in the daytime, when I urged my younger sister to marry, she resented me for it.

units.source_text: 现在又放这个人进来，不知她将何等惊怪，何等痛恨我呢。”

en.t: Now that I have let this man in as well, how shocked she will be, and how bitterly she will hate me."

units.source_text: 痛苦之极，回想过去一切事情，都是由于没有可靠的保护人而孤苦伶仃地活在世间，因而身受苦痛。

en.t: In the depth of her anguish, she thought back over everything that had happened, realizing that all her suffering came from living so lonely and helpless in the world, with no reliable protector.

units.source_text: 便觉和父亲诀别而目送他登山那天傍晚的景象，

en.t: Then the scene of that evening when she parted from her father and watched him go up the mountain

units.source_text: 仿佛就在目前，恋慕之心与悲痛之情充塞了胸中。

en.t: seemed to be right before her eyes, and longing and grief filled her breast.
